summary.text: Joseph Franklin Hernandez is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico House of Representatives since 2025, representing District 4 in San Juan County.
Hernandez sits on the House Appropriations and Finance Committee and the House Transportation, Public Works and Capital Improvements Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Hernandez's occupation as community organizer and a district office in Shiprock.
Between sessions, Hernandez is a member of the Indian Affairs Committee and the Water and Natural Resources Committee.
